coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in daverandom/libdns PHP source (Decoder, DecodingContext, Packets, Messages, Records and Types); php-fuzzer basic-block instrumentation for the fuzz entry except Records/Types/DomainName.php (see fuzz_instrumentation_note)
z_bits_note: LibDNS's decoder keeps id, QR (message type), opcode, aa, tc, rd, ra and rcode but not the Z, AD and CD bits, so the harness reports z as 0. Both controls have all three bits clear.
scope: One RFC 1035 DNS message from local bytes through LibDNS's Decoder only; no resolver, event loop or socket is created. A and AAAA text is LibDNS's own address formatting; names get a trailing dot and lower case.
fuzz_instrumentation_note: php-fuzzer v0.0.11 rewrites every file:// include through nikic/include-interceptor; its rewrite of src/Records/Types/DomainName.php (const FLAG_NO_COMPRESSION = \PHP_INT_SIZE === 4 ? -2147483648 : 0x80000000) is no longer a constant expression and PHP stops with 'Constant expression contains invalid operations'. fuzz-target.php therefore autoloads the parent class Type first, restores the native file:// wrapper for one require_once of DomainName.php and registers the interceptor's Stream wrapper again right after (the same steps as Interceptor::unwrap()/wrap()). Only that file lacks php-fuzzer edge instrumentation; harness.php and the parse path are unchanged, and Xdebug coverage and the AFL++ parser-line bridge load the file through the Composer autoloader and count its lines.
